messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — elevated gateway 5xx rate from upstream 'edge-proxy' across eu-west-1. Current 5xx rate 3.4% (SLO 1%) over 5m window. Auto-page sent to #eng-sre and oncall.

maya: Seeing it in logs too, lots of `HTTP/502` and `upstream read timeout` entries. Impacting hosted inference routes.

ben: Acknowledged. I'm oncall. Triage: is this localized to eu-west?

maya: Mostly eu-west-1, small blips in us-east. Looks like an upstream provider flapping after their deploy.

rik: Customer reports coming in: three paid customers with increased error rates on their dedicated pools. Not yet widespread but could escalate.

cleo: Starting mitigation: switching traffic for vulnerable routes to fallback pool (eu-west-2). Will patch LB weights now.

ben: Do it. Also temporary mute noisy downstream alerts while we stabilize — we keep the critical pagers.

maya: Command run: ```
# move 30% traffic away from eu-west-1
curl -XPOST https://api.internal/routing/adjust -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","from":"eu-west-1","to":"eu-west-2","pct":30}'
```

incident-bot: Action logged: routing change requested by cleo.

cleo: LB weights updated, now shifting 50% traffic. Observability: 5xx rate trending down in eu-west-1 after shift.

ben: Good. I'm going to mute the noisy infra alerts for the next 25m: `/ops mute alert infra-5xx-eu-west1 --for 25m --reason "ongoing mitigations"`. Keep the high-severity customer-impact alerts live.

maya: Doing a deeper check — upstream provider is reporting degraded edge nodes post-deploy, link: https://status.edgeprovider.example/incidents/382.

rik: Opening internal incident ticket: INT-4723. Assigning to infra and edge provider eng.

ben: Post-mitigation plan:
- keep traffic redirected until upstream stabilizes
- add short-term alert tweak: increase evaluation window to 10m for infra noise suppression
- create dashboard filter by upstream id so we can correlate provider failures
- schedule postmortem and alert retuning PR

maya: Suggestion for alert tuning: current alert `5xx_rate > 1% over 5m` is noisy for provider blips. Propose change: `5xx_rate > 1.5% over 10m OR 5xx_rate > 3% over 2m` and group by `upstream_provider` so we only page when multiple providers are affected.

cleo: Also add composite alert that combines 5xx spike + gateway latency > 200ms to reduce false positives from single-request flaps.

ben: Agree. For immediate relief, mute non-critical 5xx alerts and increase the alerting window to 10m. We'll follow up with a PR to alert rules.

incident-bot: Action: `alert.mute` executed by ben for `infra-5xx-eu-west1` until +25m.

maya: Observing errors dropping to ~0.8% in eu-west-1 now. Customers reporting fewer failures.

rik: Handing off to cleo for monitoring while I update the incident timeline and start the postmortem doc.

cleo: On it. I'll keep the routing weight at 50% until edgeprovider confirms stable and we've run two 30m observation windows.

maya: Creating dashboard widget: `5xx rate by upstream_provider` and pinned to the incident channel. Snippet: ```
- metric: infra.http.5xx_rate
- group_by: upstream_provider, region
- window: 1m, 5m, 10m
```

ben: Thanks. Next steps after stabilization:
- revert temporary mutes
- open PR in monitoring repo with updated thresholds and grouping
- coordinate with partnerships team to demand timeline from provider
- write follow-up runbook addition for provider-deployed flaps

cleo: Noted. I'll leave a sticky note in the incident doc: "tune alert to group by provider and add 10m evaluation window".

incident-bot: Incident INT-4723 updated: status -> mitigating, assignees: ben, cleo, maya.

maya: Passing on-call to Rik in 15m. Leaving monitoring and escalation playbook in the doc.

ben: Great work team. If eu-west trends under 1% for two consecutive 30m windows, we'll start reverting traffic and unmute alerts. :thumbsup:

cleo: :white_check_mark: will monitor and update channel.

rik: I'll take over on-call after handoff. Keep me @rik if anything flips.

incident-bot: NOTE: create follow-up task `MON-PR-109` for alert rule changes and dashboard work.
